prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Rough game environment concept for Duck Rails, cooperative VR horror-comedy. Low-poly economical geometry, visibly chunky pixelated textures, worn cream plaster, faded olive doors, rusty metal, dark pine silhouettes. Nighttime but readable architectural review lighting. No characters. Modern roadside motel, TWO STOREYS, L-shaped building with five repeated room bays on long wing, three bays on short wing, continuous open upper balcony facing courtyard, two exterior staircases at opposite ends. Broad circulation. This is a concept view, not measured architecture. No new shops, no swimming pool, no additional wings. Landscape image. Shot 1: eye-level wide view from southwest across a small cracked-asphalt courtyard parking lot toward the two-storey L-shaped motel. Long room wing right, short reception/laundry wing at rear, courtyard open left toward railway. About six faded parking bays with only two abandoned boxy cars, ample clear pedestrian route between cars and doors, a tall MOTEL sign, a small utilitarian open train glimpsed left. Readable warm doorway lamps and cool blue moon fill. Emphasize parking as the open foreground, motel balcony and two stairs clearly visible.
